label: completed_diagnostics_through_native_bank_v1
scope: Completed auxiliary evidence only: native fixed-q CPU60 operator cases, source CUDA gates, C2 replay/CPU error bounds, GPU diagnostic cases/arms and late-boundary controls. CPU cases and diagnostic arms are not full-split or primary-quality QA. Raw native Q/K/V PT, images, weights and credential/SSH route files are not exported. Machine paths in canonical job/launch proofs require public derivation templates with separate identities. CPU60 input accounting: 4 captured source QA reused x 5 layers x 3 codecs = 60 fixed-query operator cases; new_GPU_QA=0. Its unique_input_QA=0 column counts only newly generated model-QA cases in this CPU control, not the number of real captured queries.

counts_per_group.operator_case_formula: 4 captured source QA x 5 layers x 3 codecs = 60 operator cases
